decisions.reason: The financing terms do not alter the independently specified operating-cost basis, scope, or assumption status.
The integrated three-statement structure remains required unchanged; financing terms are inputs owned by the financing Requirement.
The general policy to disclose provisional assumptions remains valid; the financing-specific base-case terms are already represented by the source Requirement.
The debt/equity structure, rate, and tranche decision do not change the twelve-site network or its authoritative site list.
Interest rates remain a sensitivity dimension; specifying the base-case financing rate does not change the required sensitivity dimensions.
The debt schedule and DSCR output remain required unchanged; duplicating financing parameters here is unnecessary because they are maintained by the source Requirement.
The required comparison between Case F and Case G and the availability-payment mechanism remain unchanged by the base-case capital structure.
The financing decision does not change the AUD model currency, 2031 price base, or the existing currency ambiguity concerning the CAD opex input.
The selected financing structure does not alter which revenue streams must be modeled separately.
The financing terms do not change the site-level capex assumption basis, input status, or site typologies.
Financing terms affect calculated returns but do not change the independently established requirement to report equity IRR against the 16–20% target.
The financing structure does not alter the separately established CCA classes, depreciation treatment, or tax-shield modeling requirements.
